items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I worked on Bill with him several times when he was accompanying Timmy Rodgers, the comedian.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

just came out of Pittsburgh, George Benson. And of course [Errol] must have been a baby when I was at Pittsburgh. And of course, I knew Linton Garner, his brother. I worked on Bill with him several times when he was accompanying Timmy Rodgers, the comedian.
Yeah, I think he did some arranging for one of the Ekstine Bands.
